entities.summary: Periyasamy Chandrasekaran (b. 1957-04-16, Talawakelle) was a civil rights leader or advocate of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Talawakelle and Sri Lanka. Known in the fields of sri lanka, labor organizers, asia.
